title: chamaemelum inodorum
intro: Chamaemelum inodorum, commonly known as Roman chamomile, is a low-growing, perennial herb native to Europe and Western Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to have anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and sedative effects, making it beneficial for promoting relaxation and soothing digestive issues. The health benefits of Roman chamomile include reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and alleviating menstrual cramps and symptoms of menopause. The bioactive constituents of Roman chamomile include apigenin, luteolin, and chamazulene, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
